summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new features: (1) Promo list in booking wizard with eligibility checking and anti-tamper protection, (2) Hold expired report with KPIs, insights, and CSV export, (3) Transfer routes quick-add catalog with validation. All backend APIs working correctly with proper RBAC. Frontend components rendering and functioning as expected.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working correctly. No 5xx errors encountered.

integration_issues.issue: Route save validation working correctly - prevents duplicate route codes with 409 error. Form stays open to allow correction. This is correct behavior, not a bug.

success_percentage.integration: 100% (promo API, hold report, transfer routes all integrated correctly)

promo_list_feature.backend: POST /api/public/booking/promos returns correct eligibility for GATHERING500, AKHIRPEKAN10, BANDARA50 with proper reasons. Anti-tamper protection confirmed - server ignores client-sent subtotal field.
promo_list_feature.frontend: PromoPicker component displays all promos with correct eligible/ineligible states. Apply/clear functionality works correctly, total updates properly.
promo_list_feature.integration: Promo eligibility calculated server-side, discount applied correctly to quote breakdown.

hold_expired_report.backend: GET /api/reports/hold-expired returns correct structure with summary (count=2, with_proof=1, avg_hold_hours=2), rows (BK-0009, BK-0010), insights. RBAC working correctly (owner/ops 200, driver/marketing 403, no auth 401). CSV export working.
hold_expired_report.frontend: HoldExpiredReport component displays KPIs, insights, table with BK-0009 (with proof flag) and BK-0010 (with WhatsApp button). Date range selector and reload button working.
hold_expired_report.integration: Report data flows correctly from backend to frontend, WhatsApp links generated with proper encoding.

transfer_routes_feature.backend: Transfer routes CRUD endpoints working. Validation prevents duplicate route codes (409), requires at least one rate.
transfer_routes_feature.frontend: TransferRoutesPanel displays catalog with 22 quick-add buttons. Quick-add auto-fills form fields except rates (correct behavior). Form validation prevents saving without rates.
transfer_routes_feature.integration: Route creation flow working. Validation errors displayed correctly. Note: Reverse route and integration with public booking API not fully tested due to duplicate route code in test data.

anti_regression.notes: Public booking flow working (search, select vehicle, view quote, promo list). Reports page loading correctly with hold expired report at top. No 5xx errors encountered. No console errors related to new features.
